newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.30 cent higher.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.30 cent higher.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.30 cent per lb firmer on Monday, based on market orders at 1018 EDT, dealers said.
A total of 694 notices have been issued to date, NYCE said.
Floor sources noted talk of slower than normal growth in the Delta due to the heavy recent rains.
Growth in parts of Texas is also slower than normal after cool, wet weather throughout the spring, Weather Services Corp, said. No major delays are expected, however.
Friday, the most-active July contract ended 0.09 cent firmer at 72.40 cents per lb, having ranged from 72.90 to 72.15 cents. New-crop December finished down 0.12 cent to 74.93 cents.
